meta_title: Apple Green Garden Services | Gardener Birmingham
meta_description: Apple Green Garden Services in Birmingham offers professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Local experts serving Erdington and beyond. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Family Business — Over 15 Years' Experience
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations, we'll bring your outdoor space back to life.
services_subhead: We handle everything from routine maintenance to full garden redesigns — keeping your outdoor space looking cared-for all year round.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Tidying
services.desc: Fortnightly or monthly upkeep — hedge trimming, lawn mowing, weeding, and border care. We'll keep your garden looking neat without the hassle.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim your space from tangled undergrowth and dead wood. We clear, dispose of waste responsibly, and leave you with a blank canvas to work with.

services.title: Lawn Care & Restoration
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, feeding, and reseeding to transform patchy grass into a healthy, dense lawn. Ideal before spring or summer.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Pruning
services.desc: Expert trimming keeps hedges shaped and healthy whilst removing deadwood and lower branches to improve light and access.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: From patio laying to raised beds and planting schemes, we'll design and build a garden that suits your style and budget.

services.title: Seasonal Deep Cleans
services.desc: Spring and autumn clear-ups including leaf clearance, gutter cleaning, and preparing beds for planting. One-off or annual contract available.

about_pullquote: I started this because I love helping people fall back in love with their gardens.
about_para_1: Apple Green Garden Services was founded over 15 years ago by a passionate team of gardeners who wanted to help Birmingham homeowners enjoy their outdoor spaces without the stress. We've grown steadily through word-of-mouth recommendations and repeat customers — because we treat every garden like it matters, and we show up on time, every time.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're the most reliable. Our customers trust us to give honest advice, stick to our quotes, and leave their gardens looking genuinely better. Many have been with us for a decade or more — that's how we measure success.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our garden was completely out of control — 18 months of overgrowth. The team came in, cleared everything in two days, and left it ready for us to redesign. Really fair price too. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: I've had them maintain our garden for 5 years now. Reliable, friendly, turn up when they say they will. Not the flashiest outfit but they know what they're doing and genuinely care about the work. That's rare.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Brilliant team. Came and gave us a free assessment, explained exactly what needed doing and why. No pressure. They've just finished our hedge and lawn work and it looks brilliant. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David K.
